== Biography ==
Juan Ignacio Abdón was born in Montevideo, Uruguay. He is currently in college, studying to become a Computer Programmer/Engineer. He began playing League of Legends in August, 2010. The first champion he played was Gragas. When the Latin America South server launched, he decided to create a serious team to play in tournaments. He has had the full support of his family in his gaming career.
